meta.title: SSOT Cutover — Console Slop Report
meta.description: Root-cause trace of the React 19 console warnings on the Ulta storefront after the Zustand webSiteStore cutover. One shared root cause, four symptoms, exact file:lines and fixes.

props.title: Console Slop: One Root Cause, Four Symptoms
props.subtitle: The cutover made the Zustand store a carrier for un-scrubbed module metadata, which a 6-layer prop-spread pipeline lands on native <a> / <button> elements.
props.meta: Traced 2026-06-25 · web-dx feature/DSP-155-ssot · 30+ files in the blast radius

props.content: Issues #1 and #3 are the SAME bug. Pre-cutover, PageDataProvider scrubbed module metadata before it reached leaf components. M9 replaced it with componentManager store writes that do NO shape filtering — so moduleName, _parentModules, anchorId, and the nested action object ride an unfiltered {...spread} chain until palette Link.jsx / Button.jsx splat them onto the DOM. Issues #2 and #4 are local to the BoughtTogether module.

props.label: ROOT CAUSE
props.title: The Unfiltered Spread Pipeline
props.subtitle: spreadProps drops only null/undefined — never runtime keys. Nothing strips props at the DOM boundary.

props.filename: the load-bearing (non) filter + the DOM sink

props.content: Carrier chain (every hop forwards everything): LayerHost.js:377 → Modules.js:41-42 → AsyncComponent.js:31,39 → LoadableComponent.js:21 → Loadable → leaf module {...props} → palette <a {...other}> / <button {...other}>. The cutover made componentManager.byId[id].data the carrier — broadcastComponent (webSiteActions.js:396-437) writes event.content || event into the store with no scrub, then LayerHost.componentStateUpdateHandler (LayerHost.js:427-458) splats it straight back into localProps on every re-render.

props.label: THE FOUR SYMPTOMS
props.title: What Shows Up In The Console
props.subtitle: Each links to an exact source. Severity in the title.

props.title: #1 · Unknown DOM props · P1
props.content: 9 runtime keys land on native elements: moduleName, _parentModules, _isPrepareForCacheExecuted, anchorId, clientActionType, clientActionParams, navigationType, dataCaptureData, customHeaders. Sinks: web-palette Link.jsx:163 (…other → <a>) and Button.jsx:111 (…other → <button>). On SSR these round-trip as DOM attributes → React 19 hydration mismatch.

props.title: #2 · Nested <a> hydration · P1
props.content: BoughtTogether.js:110-116 wraps a MiniProductCard (which renders its OWN inner <a> via ProductCardHorizontal → palette) inside an outer Link_Huge anchor. The author zeroed action={null} at line 72 but not primaryAction, so the inner link still renders. React 19 tears down + re-renders the whole subtree; also breaks screen readers.

props.title: #3 · action prop on non-form · P1
props.content: React 19 reserved action for <form>. Same spread sinks as #1. getLinkHtml.js:46 and getButtonHtml.js:37 pass action={action} (commented 'needed for DC'); it falls through any leaf that does {...spreadProps({...props})} without destructuring action — e.g. the CLP path ProductListingResults.js:33 → MiniProductCard.js:183 → core Button → palette <button action>.

props.title: #4 · setState during render · P1 dev / P2 prod
props.content: BoughtTogether.js:259-262 calls setShowSpacer(false) in the render body. setShowSpacer is owned by LayerHost (useState at LayerHost.js:113, passed down at :389). Old 'lift state up' antipattern; React 19 dev surfaces it and the store-driven re-renders fire it on every page + overlay churn.

props.filename: Link.jsx — destructure misses action + runtime keys

props.label: SHARED ROOT-CAUSE MAP
props.title: Which Issues Collapse Into One Fix

rows.root: BoughtTogether wraps a card that renders its own <a>
Lifted setShowSpacer called in render, not an effect

props.label: THE DEEPER FIX
props.title: Sanitize at the store write boundary
props.subtitle: Fix it once where data enters the store, not at every DOM read.

props.content: Fixes #2 and #4 are local one-liners. But the prop-spread leak is structural: 30+ modules forward {...props} trusting an upstream scrub that the cutover removed. Patching each palette sink is necessary but treats the symptom. The durable fix is to strip SSOT-internal fields (_parentModules, _isPrepareForCacheExecuted, anchorId, internal meta/action descriptors) inside broadcastComponent (webSiteActions.js:396-437) BEFORE they enter componentManager.byId[*].data — and replace the {...spreadProps({...localProps})} at LayerHost.js:377 with an explicit Content-contract allow-list (the PropTypes at LayerHost.js:1072-1082 are already the start of that contract). Then the store carries only contract-shaped data and every downstream spread is clean by construction.
